Calculus.description: Hardened dental plaque (tartar) on teeth surface, especially near gumline.
Calculus.treatment: Professional dental scaling and polishing every 6 months

Caries.description: Tooth decay caused by bacterial acid erosion of tooth enamel.
Caries.treatment: Dental filling, crown for large cavities, root canal if pulp involved

Gingivitis.description: Inflammation of the gums, the earliest stage of gum disease.
Gingivitis.treatment: Professional cleaning, improved oral hygiene, antibacterial mouthwash

Mouth_Ulcer.description: Painful sores on the inner lining of the mouth (aphthous ulcers).
Mouth_Ulcer.treatment: Topical corticosteroids, antiseptic mouthwash, vitamin B12 if deficient

Tooth_Discoloration.description: Changes in tooth color from intrinsic (internal) or extrinsic (surface) causes.
Tooth_Discoloration.treatment: Professional whitening, veneers, or crowns depending on cause

Hypodontia.description: Congenital condition with one or more missing permanent teeth.
Hypodontia.treatment: Dental implants, bridges, partial dentures, or orthodontic space closure
